name: Butter Bridge retry-message hash collision
summary: Butter Bridge stored failed-message commitments with abi.encodePacked over adjacent dynamic byte fields. The attacker retried a valid failed message with different field boundaries but the same packed preimage, redirecting execution to MAPO and minting one quadrillion unbacked tokens.

loss.notes: The exploit minted 1,000,000,000,000,000 unbacked MAPO, far beyond legitimate supply, so a pre-attack MAPO spot mark is not realizable. Six blocks later the attacker sold exactly 1,000,000,000 MAPO through the Uniswap v4 MAPO/ETH pool and received 52.210047945812131055 ETH. The receipt and trace agree on both quantities. ETH is valued at the DefiLlama observation immediately before the sale. The remaining forged MAPO is excluded because no further realization was identified; the exact onchain proceeds replace the legacy $180,000 estimate.

ageReset.description: The fifth and final pre-exploit Upgraded event selected the implementation executed by the exploit. The EIP-1967 slot and implementation runtime remain unchanged through the pre-exploit block.

sources.note: Reviewed the exploit and setup receipts and call traces, exact orderList states, attacker helper deployment, sale trace, proxy creation trace, complete Upgraded-event history, historical EIP-1967 slot and runtimes, commit-pinned reproduction and vulnerable project source, patch diff, historical ETH price, and project incident report. A valid messageIn transaction at block 25137528 stored a failed retry commitment for order 0xf2fbaa8a33bc05e0454299f2d43ed99fdb5cf024770484bbb598ace5e0c7d4a4 after verified delivery to a non-contract failed. Its orderList value remained unchanged until the exploit 44 blocks later. BridgeAbstract hashed adjacent dynamic initiator, from, to, and swapData fields with abi.encodePacked; retryMessageIn reconstructed the same undelimited preimage from attacker-selected field boundaries. The exploit therefore passed the stored-hash check without a new proof and made the proxy call MAPO.mapoExecute, minting exactly 1,000,000,000,000,000 MAPO to 0x40592025392bd7d7463711c6e82ed34241b64279. The next project source commit replaced the packed hash with abi.encode and a nested swapData hash. Six blocks after the mint, transaction 0xf7d46fa31a273fbfd5f11c9c1c57179a8fb722cec51d817ad7e8ff8aa31206d3 sold exactly 1,000,000,000 MAPO through Uniswap v4 and paid the attacker 52.210047945812131055 ETH, worth $111,550.49090514675 at the nearest preceding DefiLlama ETH observation of $2,136.5713170944223. Proxy 0x0000317bec33af037b5fab2028f52d14658f6a56 was created by transient CREATE contract 0x67181a3c543c16b01cba2e5ca166cd1c19d33d23 in transaction 0xf93aee2427b87e62c5d5961930529d02d46e6afbbc53ad68488250458a8212e4 at block 21074938 index 60, timestamp 1730248799. A complete query returns five pre-exploit Upgraded events. The final event, transaction 0xb85f4e2f2464f9bffddc7c6307ab8834e2ff0bf7a8b7997b4fdd1123215c4566 at block 23086108 index 134, log 299, timestamp 1754532599, selected implementation 0x92feada957bbeb17868f9f59aed548e50191283d. The EIP-1967 slot changed from 0x9623c6d973f173e56d369bb1ecc605695a065a95 to that address at the block boundary and stayed there through block 25137571; the exploit trace delegates to it. Its 15,566-byte runtime hash is 0xea55727ea8f13f78ee5c495f2b06956cffdbf124792c27947ca993c63785a636 at activation and immediately before exploitation. The attacker-created failed message is exploit preparation, not a victim reset. Code age is 1779293639 - 1754532599 = 24,761,040 seconds.
